gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-alike-angular: Alike Angular reads like a classic serif with a gentle thick-and-thin rhythm, its letters held open rather than curled shut. And Balsamiq Sans pushes against it with bold, plain stencil-like lines that never swell or pinch.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-alyamama: Chunky, hand-cut headlines meet a softer text face. Alyamama is the classic serif here, its curve endings kept well apart and its thick-thin shift mild, which gives Balsamiq Sans a steady, refined partner.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-andada-pro: Marker-bold up top, bookish below. Balsamiq Sans is best at sweeping curves that never thin out, and Andada Pro is best at medium-range modulation with counters the eye slips through.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-aref-ruqaa: Balsamiq Sans draws every stroke at a constant weight, like ink poured through a stencil channel. Aref Ruqaa brings the opposite strength: a serif with open bowls and a mellow swing from thick to thin.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-aref-ruqaa-ink: Aref Ruqaa Ink reads like a classic serif with lightly modulated strokes and apertures that stay open throughout. Balsamiq Sans sets bold lettering against it.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-average: Literary in tone, Average is a classic serif with gaping mouths on its e and a faint reed-pen thickening in the curves. But Balsamiq Sans keeps its monoline strokes, so a long page moves from loud headline to bookish, unhurried text.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-besley: Balsamiq Sans leads with a stencil-channel line that never tilts or pinches, while Besley follows as a dignified text serif with open curves. Their strongest quality is plain boldness against editorial restraint.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-bona-nova: Bookish and editorial, Bona Nova swells only slightly in its curves and keeps its mouths open on every round letter. Balsamiq Sans is strongest at stout, pipe-cleaner strokes; the serif is strongest at fine, restrained detail.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-bona-nova-sc: Balsamiq Sans is stout and bold, built from strokes with no hairlines. Bona Nova SC, a refined text serif, keeps small counters unclogged and its modulation gentle, so a longer passage stays light and easy to follow.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-brawler: Balsamiq Sans draws a marker-like line of constant weight that never pinches into tight curves. Brawler, a classic serif with clear openings, adds modest modulation, so the pair's strongest quality is expressive boldness over refined text.
